questions.q: Where does a comment left through a pulse actually end up?
o: In a spreadsheet the automation keeps
Only in the next pulse email
As a CRM Note titled [Ops Pulse] or [Sales Pulse], attached to the record and its company
As a reply in the sales@ mailbox
questions.e: Comments are stored as CRM Notes with an [Ops Pulse] or [Sales Pulse] title prefix. The prefix is how the pulse reads them back and re-renders them under the item.

questions.q: In the Tuesday pipeline sweep, which source wins on a deal's amount and probability?
o: Neither - the row is flagged for review
questions.e: The sheet wins on amount, probability and next step. The CRM wins on stage and close date, so the sweep never invents a speculative date or silently moves a deal's stage.

questions.q: Which pulse button will not let you finish without picking a reason?
questions.e: The Lost confirm page requires a reason from the list: price, lead time, lost to competitor, no budget, no decision, stalled or other. Free text is optional and is kept as a comment.

questions.q: How long do the buttons in a pulse email keep working?
o: Until the next pulse is sent
questions.e: Every button link is signed and expires after 21 days. Work from today's pulse rather than an archived one.
